questions: What is accessibility?
If accessibility is added, can everyone use it in the same way?
What does transparency mean?
If transparency is high, will people know why they got the result?
What is privacy?
If privacy is protected, can information still be shared?
What is a recommendation?
If a recommendation is ignored, does it stop influencing what comes next?
What is trust?
If trust is broken, can people still rely on it?
What is an interface?
If the interface disappears, can people still tell what to do?
What is feedback?
If feedback comes late, does the action still feel connected to its result?
What is presence?
If presence is low, are people effectively absent?
What is moderation?
If moderation is removed, does everything become unrestricted?
What is a notification?
If a notification is dismissed, does it stop affecting attention?
What is bias?
If bias is removed, will every group receive the same outcome?
What is a persona?
If a persona changes, does the same person remain underneath?
What is consent?
If consent is withdrawn, does everything already given disappear?
What is automation?
If automation takes over, does nobody need to make decisions anymore?
What is friction?
If friction is reduced, will people always get through faster?
